description.p: View and control multiple Tapo cameras from a standalone Linux desktop application using the Tapo cloud service.

Topo supports live video and audio, cloud connection checks, privacy mode, pan and tilt, per-camera fullscreen, MFA login, session reuse, logout, and full SD-card recording playback with MP4 downloads.
Topo is an independent third-party application and is not affiliated with or endorsed by TP-Link or Tapo. It uses undocumented Tapo cloud endpoints and may require updates when the service changes.

description.p: Improved long-running live stream stability with automatic recovery after temporary relay interruptions or stalled playback.
Reduced live-preview latency and made low-latency playback the default live experience.
Added full SD-card clip playback and MP4 downloads, per-camera live audio volume control, native save dialogs, and a compact newest-first recording list.
Stabilized the GitHub Pages deployment and added the Windows release workflow.
Fixed the fullscreen Controls button moving when the command drawer opens.
Added an Info button that opens the Topo project website.
